entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
People are mopping up in Oamaru after the town was hit by an intense, highly localised downpour that flooded homes and businesses.

Waitaki Civil Defence controller Roger Cook said people should stay inside and out of the floodwater if possible and contact emergency services if they were concerned about their safety.

⚠️ RNZ is New Zealand's statutory civil defence lifeline radio broadcaster, providing vital information and updates as they come to hand. All frequencies can be found at rnz.co.nz/listen
